verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents a separate sandbox environment that covers all products except Connected Account APIs, with self-serve signup and per-product simulations. AI agents can reach it through the sandbox Developer MCP, and the CLI defaults to sandbox, with production only on explicit `--prod`. This is true environment isolation, not a dry-run mode. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and sandbox coverage of Connected Account APIs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Airwallex provides a sandbox environment, completely separate from the production environment, for testing your integration through simulations without using real money.
The Airwallex developer connectors connects AI coding agents — Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, and similar tools — to Airwallex documentation and the Airwallex sandbox.
so you can read and write your Airwallex resources in sandbox or production, script repeatable tasks, and wire Airwallex into automated systems
